dialectical_engagement.objection_handling: revisionary rather than eliminative; retains intentional vocabulary while revising ontology
objections_raised: beliefs are too heterogeneous for scientific laws

method_and_evidence.evidence_type: conceptual analysis, analogies, scientific practice, thought experiments

philosophical_orientation.thematic_focus: philosophy of cognitive science, philosophy of mind, mental representation

structural_organization.structure_type: dialectical progression through nine sections, from thesis to antithesis to synthesis, ending with rejection of eliminativism

summary_of_core_decisions: The essay defends a layered, pluralistic cognitive science in which propositional attitudes are legitimate higher-level functional states, realized by computational and neural mechanisms, but not fundamental entities. It rejects eliminativism while accepting revisionary refinement.
